crossRefs.note: I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Rise, Peter, kill and eat!’

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Rise, Peter, kill and eat!’
translations.bsb: Then I heard a voice saying to me, ‘Get up, Peter, kill and eat.’
translations.kjv: And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.
translations.asv: And I heard also a voice saying unto me, Rise, Peter; kill and eat.
